person_note: The controlling narrator is anonymous and nonparticipating, using close third person centered on Jean Louise. Quotes q03503, q03520, q03522, and q03525 expose that external position, while the apparent first-person event passages q03505, q03511, and q03513 are Jean Louise's unquoted interior monologue in contiguous third-person scenes. Dialogue, scripture, and gnomic I/we material are likewise local rather than base narration. Some secondary analyses call the abrupt interior passages person 'slips,' but neither the excerpts nor structural sources identify sustained first- or second-person sections, so they do not warrant ALTERNATING. The only remaining uncertainty is the stylistic boundary between direct interior monologue and free-indirect discourse, not the controlling narrative person.
